diagnostics.description: Diagnostic output. Changes what is recorded, not what is computed.

sheafAblationLog.description: Append sheaf ablation records to this file. Replaces LEYLINE_SHEAF_ABLATION_LOG.

sessionCorpus.description: The session corpus the session-observation pass reads. `null`: the pass does nothing. Replaces LEYLINE_SESSION_CORPUS.

head.description: How heads are signed and verified.

requireSignature.description: Refuse an unsigned head. Replaces LEYLINE_HEAD_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE.

signingKey.description: The Ed25519 seed that signs heads, as a file holding 64 hex characters. `null`: heads are written unsigned. Replaces LEYLINE_HEAD_SIGNING_KEY.

trustedKeys.description: Ed25519 public key files a head signature is verified against. A set. Replaces LEYLINE_HEAD_TRUSTED_KEYS.

ipAddress.description: An IP literal in its one spelling: IPv4 as a dotted quad with no leading zero, IPv6 in RFC 5952 canonical text. The parser refuses any other spelling of a valid address (`non-canonical-address`); this pattern states the alphabet only.

label.description: 1 to 64 characters of ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or digit.

parser.description: What the parser runs, shared by both daemon kinds and read by `parse`, `verify-head` and `rebuild` from `--config`.

queryMatchLimit.description: The tree-sitter query match limit. Replaces LLO_QUERY_MATCH_LIMIT.

queryProgressBudget.description: The query progress budget. Replaces LLO_QUERY_PROGRESS_BUDGET.

trustedQueryHashes.description: BLAKE3 digests of tree-sitter query files the parser may load beyond the compiled set. A set: sorted in the resolved document, a duplicate refused. Replaces LLO_TRUSTED_QUERY_HASHES.

path.description: An absolute path, or one beginning `~/`, which resolves against HOME. No empty, `.` or `..` component and no trailing `/`. UTF-8 without U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F, U+2028, U+2029, `"` or `\`.

queryHash.description: A BLAKE3 digest of a tree-sitter query file: 64 lowercase hex characters.

secretRef.description: A reference to a secret; never its value (ADR-0049 D4). v1 delivers `file`. `keychain` and `vault` are reserved: a v1 binary refuses them by name (`secret-ref-not-delivered`). Any other key is `unknown-key`; a string, number, array or other object in a secret field is `secret-inlined`.

source.description: The source tree the daemon's store is parsed from. `null` (the default) means none.

language.description: A language filter. `null` detects the language per file.

description: The deployment configuration of `leyline daemon` (ADR-0049). Every optional field states its default; an omitted field means that default, never "unset". Rules this schema cannot state, and which the parser enforces (README "Rules"): a key twice in one object, a JSON escape in a string, a non-canonical IP spelling, a duplicate set entry, the cross-field rules, and the host checks.

sizeMib.description: The arena size in MiB. Replaces --arena-size-mib.

enabled.description: Activate or resume the private CDC index over source_blobs. Replaces --cdc.

target.description: The CDC target. Inert when `enabled` is false. Replaces --cdc-target.

control.x-leyline-default: arena.path with its extension replaced by .ctrl

mcp.description: The MCP surface. Off unless a listener is configured.

groups.description: The Cloister groups the listeners' callers are granted. A set. `null`: every group. Replaces --mcp-groups.

http.description: An MCP HTTP listener. `null`: none. Replaces --mcp-port, --mcp-bind and --mcp-allow-public.

noAuth.description: Disable the ADR-0022 token gate on both listeners. Replaces --mcp-no-auth.

tokenFile.description: The ADR-0022 shared-secret token, generated (exclusively, never through a symlink) when absent.

uds.description: An MCP listener on this Unix socket. `null`: none. Replaces --mcp-uds.

mount.description: Serve the store as a filesystem here. `null` (the default) runs headless. Replaces --mount, --backend and --nfs-port.

backend.x-leyline-default: nfs on macOS, fuse on Linux

nfsPort.description: The NFS listen port; 0 lets the kernel pick.

shutdownAfterSeconds.description: Shut down after this many seconds; 0 shuts down at once. `null`: no automatic shutdown. Replaces --timeout.
